article.story: Fairleigh Dickinson Knights (1-2) at East Texas A&M Lions (2-0) Commerce, Texas; Wednesday, 11:30 a.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: East Texas A&M hosts Fairleigh Dickinson after Mohamed Diakite scored 23 points in East Texas A&M's 72-71 victory against the Rice Owls. East Texas A&M went 11-21 overall last season while going 6-8 at home. The Lions averaged 70.2 points per game while shooting 43.3% from the field and 32.3% from deep last season. Fairleigh Dickinson finished 11-21 overall a season ago while going 3-15 on the road. The Knights averaged 5.1 steals, 1.5 blocks and 10.9 turnovers per game last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
